headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 29, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a thrilling 6-4 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Luis García Jr. hitting 3 home runs and driving in 5 runs. The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 9-4 defeat at the hands of the Pittsburgh Pirates, while the Texas Rangers edged out the Toronto Blue Jays in a close game, winning 3-2. The Houston Astros secured a 7-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Isaac Paredes leading the Astros' offense.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Keegan Akin of the Baltimore Orioles, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. The Chicago Cubs have also placed Matt Shaw on the 10-day injured list with a left-hand sprain and Ethan Roberts on the 15-day injured list with right forearm inflammation. Other teams have also reported injuries, including the Athletics, Minnesota Twins, San Diego Padres, and Washington Nationals.

The Seattle Mariners have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. The Athletics have also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Hayden Juenger from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Owen Carapellotti. The Chicago Cubs have traded left-hander David Peterson to the New York Mets for third baseman Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 6-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a hard-fought win against the Baltimore Orioles, with a strong performance from Luis García Jr. who hit 3 home runs and drove in 5 runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Pirates in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 9-4 defeat at the hands of the Pittsburgh Pirates. Ryan O'Hearn led the Reds' offense with a 3-hit, 2-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Blue Jays in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers edged out the Toronto Blue Jays in a close game, winning 3-2. Nathan Lukes led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 7-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Isaac Paredes leading the Astros' offense. Paredes recorded 3 hits, including a home run, and drove in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Place Keegan Akin on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to June 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash.
